title: Version 1.35.0
body:
Version 1.35.0

August 9th, 2023

Added:

  • Added new dialogue UI to all the NPCs!
  • Added the new planker machine
  • Added rough planks

Changes:

  • Changed coloring of UI elements
  • Updated branding of Typical Developers
  • Rewrote schematic behavior from scratch, schematics should be 2x more performant
  • Flashlight now functions better on characters
  • Schematics now require trust from each user to be filled
  • Tools can no longer be picked up if they are anchored
  • Buffed Rusty Pickaxe

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed vehicles jittering
  • Fixed trailers weighing down vehicles heavily
  • Fixed the Joop Grand Barrow spinning out
  • Other misc. bug fixes we forgot to note down
